title: Navy Officially Releases Controversial UFO Videos - The War Zone
snippet: The War Zone on the Pentagon's 2020 release of the Navy UAP videos.
quote: The aerial phenomena observed in the videos remain characterized as "unidentified."
stance_why: Pentagon statement confirming DoD-authenticated videos remain unidentified, supporting the skeptic's authenticated-data leg.

title: Dr. Jon Kosloski: AARO Media Roundtable on FY24 UAP Report - Unidentified Phenomena
snippet: Writeup of AARO director Kosloski's Nov 2024 media roundtable (links defense.gov).
quote: Dr. Kosloski highlighted that less than 3.5% of all cases exhibit truly anomalous characteristics, which could suggest advanced or breakthrough technology.
stance_why: AARO director's own 'truly anomalous' figure supports the skeptic's point that an official investigating office admits cases it cannot explain. Source is an enthusiast-site writeup of the roundtable, not a primary DoD release.
